package stslogsagentextension

import (
	"time"

	"github.com/stackvista/sts-opentelemetry-collector/common/logsagent"
)

func faultDiscoveryOptions() discoveryOptions {
	options := defaultDiscoveryOptions()
	options.query.Timeout = 5 * time.Second
	options.query.AttemptTimeout = 5 * time.Second
	options.query.MaxAttempts = 1
	options.poll.Interval = 100 * time.Millisecond
	options.poll.Jitter = 0
	options.restartCooldown = 30 * time.Second
	if logsagent.FaultEnabled("short_cooldown") {
		options.restartCooldown = 2 * time.Second
	}
	return options
}
